wheel_unit: Target rad/s; feedback reported interface values, physical scale unverified.
initial_window_policy: Original anchored validate, first qualifying >=3-second static window with >=25 synchronized source-time pairs; no refit.
endpoint_window_policy: First complete fixed 15-second window from final zero command +4 through +19 seconds; missing intervals are retained. Separate original static validation also recorded.
completion_policy: Visit the immutable combined approach, START and inspection path in order before usual END tolerances can report success.
recording_policy: Record native base pose plus frozen map/odom, original actual/reference paths, mocap validity and wheel data. High-rate joint-only TF is omitted; full pose information remains reconstructible.
distance_window_policy: Same motion-boundary definition as baseline: first nonzero final chassis command through first zero after last arrival nonzero plus 1 s; continuous native base_link source stamps; report gaps and do not bridge intervals >0.5 s.
middle_measurement_policy: Original static validation during one brief middle hold, no pose correction; moving comparisons remain diagnostic.
middle_pause_policy: Original Nav2 velocity_smoother parameter services temporarily hold zero, restore saved limits after static sampling, keep the same full-route goal.
middle_target_policy: Parking trigger on the original generated 0.60 m path, nearest prior mid-camera coverage center; prior data only choose a stopping location and are never used as current truth.
monitor_note: Latest-state monitor is capped; full original streams remain recorded in the bag.
display_profile_note: Run without RViz during measurement, restore original scene afterwards.
wheel_recording_policy: User requested only partial wheel samples sufficient for curves; official topic_tools throttle retains selected original messages, no interpolation or fabricated values.
runtime_note: Frozen estimator, map, controller and sensor parameters unchanged. Initial-only acquisition consumers are released after freezing; unchanged zero command journal heartbeat is sampled at 20 Hz and every command change remains recorded and checked.
initialization_load_note: Frozen initial-only bridge releases acquisition-only mocap and command consumers; native pose and TF ownership audits remain active.

recording_interruption.cause: Recorder SQLite database locked during concurrent read-only inspection; recorder aborted. Original navigation and static validator recorders continued.
recording_interruption.tracking_source: Original executor retained actual_path contains its complete sampled map trajectory.

result_limits: Complete original map trajectory and initial/middle/endpoint static measurements retained. Native LIO odometry recording missing between roughly 30 and 263 s; no full native LIO travel total is reported. Wheel curves show measured portions only.
